messages.text:
Hi Laura, not sure how much detail you wanna go into but if I were to summarize my notes:

What went well:
• Thoughtful approach to the exercise, understood the goal quickly
• Good analytical thinking and statistical maturity
• Strong communication, explained reasoning clearly
• Comfortable working across SQL, dashboards, ML, prototypes - IOW, good for a startup environment like ours
• Pragmatic about experimentation and A/B testing

Good analytical thinking and statistical maturity
Strong communication, explained reasoning clearly
Comfortable working across SQL, dashboards, ML, prototypes - IOW, good for a startup environment like ours

messages.text:
Where it softened a little:
• Tended to lean more toward investigation/analysis rather than quickly landing on a concrete action. E.g. in the in the politics retention scenario, the analysis around platform shifts and competitors was good, but waht I was looking for is a faster “here’s the experiment I’d run next week” type answer
• On Qs around proving recommendations, the answer was a bit light on measurement details (uplift, counterfactuals, etc.)
• In a couple places he preferred "gathering more information first" rather than making a directional call and testing it
